required_checks: Canonical query must return exactly one actual net object for this fast path, and its full NAME must be a member of the independently acquired complete group. Preserve seed, canonical identity, raw source values and epoch.
Use actual objects, never guess top from no slash or a clock name. -of_objects get_nets documentation does not promise net-input support; use the documented actual pin form.
Do not conflate -parent_net with top: parent_net is the segment attached to the driver leaf pin, and the options are mutually exclusive.
Keep complete group membership proof for all80 direct nets. Top-source optimization does not replace80 actual endpoint associations.
Primary ports are queried from the actual highest-level segment; do not enable scoped/prop_thru_buffers options that alter the physical group semantics.

Record full-group queries K and canonical selector queries K separately. Canonical selector uses -segments too; total such invocations may be2K. It is not legitimate to report onlyK total -segments calls.
Top selection is an additional O(K) candidate operation. The docs establish meaning, not that it avoids all internal traversal or gives a particular runtime speedup.

Canonical0/multiple/foreign group result is not proof of empty ports. Reject the fast path or explicitly use a separately validated full-group path with its cost/error evidence; never silently fabricate a singleton.

Do not narrow leaf-driver queries to top only based on these docs: get_pins says -leaf includes primitive/black-box pins but does not explicitly establish complete alias-group equivalence in this text. Keep actual leaf-source query on the complete set once per group until separately proven.
error_propagation_finding: All three manuals explicitly say -quiet returns TCL_OK regardless of errors occurring inside the command. Proof-critical future queries should omit -quiet and preserve catch/-errorinfo; an empty valid leaf or port collection must not hide an internal query failure.
additional_targeted_tests: Canonical selector yields a genuine group member despite names with slashes or misleading root-looking aliases.
Canonical query empty/multiple/foreign group result rejected; direct mappings/group membership still required.
Spy counters distinguish N direct, K full closure, optional K canonical, K leaf and K port calls.
API internal failure must propagate even when another source field alone looks legal; future query implementation cannot hide it via -quiet.
installation_tree_scan: Only bounded top entries and exact doc/eng/man command files; no full install scan.
